# RouterIPHub - Complete Programmatic Technical Knowledgebase
Date: 2026-11-03
Website: https://routeriphub.com

## 1. Gateway IP Directory
- IP: 192.168.1.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Netgear, ASUS, Linksys, Cisco, Verizon Fios, Ubiquiti
  Default Credentials: admin / admin or admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-1/

- IP: 192.168.0.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: TP-Link, D-Link, Arris, Sky Broadband, Virgin Media
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or created on first boot)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-0-1/

- IP: 10.0.0.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24 standard local allocation)
  Brands: Xfinity (Comcast), Apple AirPort, Cisco, Spectrum
  Default Credentials: admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-1/

- IP: 192.168.1.254
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: AT&T Fiber (BGW320), BT Smart Hub (UK), Plusnet, 2Wire
  Default Credentials: admin / Printed Access Code
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-254/

- IP: 192.168.2.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Belkin, SMC, Bell Home Hub (Canada), Philips Hue Bridge
  Default Credentials: admin / [empty] or admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-2-1/

- IP: 192.168.8.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Huawei, GL.iNet Travel Routers, 4G/5G Mobile Hotspots
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-8-1/

- IP: 192.168.10.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Trendnet, ZyXEL, Motorola Gateway combos
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-10-1/

- IP: 192.168.11.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Buffalo AirStation, DD-WRT Japanese releases
  Default Credentials: root / [empty] or admin / password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-11-1/

- IP: 192.168.12.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: T-Mobile 5G Home Internet (KVD21, Arcadyan, Sagemcom)
  Default Credentials: admin / sticker password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-12-1/

- IP: 192.168.31.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Xiaomi Mi WiFi, Redmi Routers
  Default Credentials: admin / set on first boot via miwifi.com
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-31-1/

- IP: 192.168.68.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: TP-Link Deco Whole Home Mesh Series (X55, XE75, BE85)
  Default Credentials: Managed via TP-Link Deco App
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-68-1/

- IP: 192.168.88.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: MikroTik RouterBOARD & RouterOS (hAP, RB series)
  Default Credentials: admin / [empty]
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-88-1/

- IP: 192.168.100.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Huawei ONT, Motorola & Arris Cable Modems, Virgin Media Modem Mode
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or TelecomAdmin)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-100-1/

- IP: 192.168.178.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: AVM FRITZ!Box (7590 AX, 6660 Cable, 5590 Fiber)
  Default Credentials: admin / sticker password
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-178-1/

- IP: 10.0.1.1
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Apple AirPort Extreme, AirPort Time Capsule, Cisco
  Default Credentials: admin / admin (or configured via AirPort Utility)
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-1-1/

- IP: 10.0.0.138
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Telstra (Australia), Thomson / SpeedTouch, Technicolor
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/10-0-0-138/

- IP: 192.168.1.2
  Subnet: 255.255.255.0 (/24)
  Brands: Wi-Fi Range Extenders, Secondary Access Points, Repeater Hubs
  Default Credentials: admin / admin
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/ip/192-168-1-2/

## 2. Hardware Models Database
- Model: Netgear Nighthawk AX6 (RAX50)
  IP: 192.168.1.1
  Domain: http://routerlogin.net
  Credentials: admin / password
  Reset: With the router powered ON, press and hold the recessed Reset pinhole on the rear panel with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the Power LED starts blinking amber. Release and wait 2-3 minutes for the factory restart.
  URL: https://routeriphub.com/routers/netgear-nighthawk-rax50/
